extraction_text: 持国请求全胜详细描述婆罗多国、雪山国和诃利国的地域、寿命、果实、优缺点以及过去、现在和未来的情况。

attributes.relationship: 持国是俱卢族国王，全胜是持国的御者和侍臣

extraction_text: 全胜向持国解释婆罗多国的四个时代：圆满时代、三分时代、二分时代和争斗时代。

attributes.details: 描述了每个时代的寿命、人物特征和道德状况

extraction_text: 全胜说明在争斗时代，人的寿命没有定数，有的在胎中或生下就死去，人们精力衰微、易怒、贪婪、欺诳、妒忌、骄傲、粗暴、虚妄、愤怒、激动。

attributes.context: 二分时代即将结束，争斗时代的特点

extraction_text: 全胜比较各国状况：雪山国优于婆罗多国，诃利国优于雪山国。

attributes.ranking: 诃利国 > 雪山国 > 婆罗多国

extraction_text: Description of the six main mountains in Kusha continent

extraction_text: Description of the seven countries in Kusha continent

attributes.details: The seven countries are Audvita, Venumandala, Rathakara, Parana, Daritiman, Parabhakara, and Kapila.

extraction_text: Description of the inhabitants and activities in these countries

attributes.details: Devas, Gandharvas, and all beings play and enjoy here; people never die, there are no Dasayus or Mlechhas, and most people are fair and delicate.

extraction_text: Description of mountains in Krauncha continent

extraction_text: Description of countries in Krauncha continent

attributes.details: Countries include Kushala, Manonuga, Ushna, Paravaraka, Andakaraka, Munidesha, and Dundubhisvana.

extraction_text: Description of inhabitants in Krauncha continent

attributes.details: Siddhas and Charanas are everywhere, skin color is predominantly white, and Devas and Gandharvas frequently appear in these countries.

extraction_text: Description of Pushkara mountain in Pushkara continent
